title: Real devices driven by Agentic AI: 2048 on mobile and web at once
description:
Can an AI agent drive several real devices at the same time? Here one test script starts on a real Android phone (Samsung S21) and on a real web browser at once, and an AI plays 2048 on both, simultaneously.

What you see:
1. The Device page, filtered to a phone and a browser: one script starts on both.
2. The game loads, then every move is the AI model's own decision, on each device.
3. The phone in big: each swipe is an AI decision, live.
4. The report: every move is a step, with the model's choice, its reason and the score.
5. The last move: its AI call, the swipe, and the board read before and after.
6. The proof: the screenshot of the board after the last move.
